services.desc: Spend eight full hours on the water with our guided kayak fishing trips, designed specifically for those who enjoy the quiet focus and strategy of kayak angling. Start times are adjusted based on tides and seasons, typically launching around 6:00 a.m. for ideal fishing windows. You can opt for pick-up and drop-off service or meet your guide directly at the ramp. This trip is limited to guests aged 16 and older to ensure safety and comfort for all participants. Pricing is for one guest; additional fees apply for extra anglers. Whether you're planning your first family-friendly fishing trip or looking to time your outing for a shot at a personal best, our reports are here to guide you. Courtney Ashburn shares his expert knowledge on conditions, bait preferences, tidal behavior, and seasonal shifts that affect the inshore bite.
